Initial release: Query pre-built, hosted datasets from Crawlora for bulk or aggregate research, without live crawling.

- Supports full-text search, faceting, record lookup, and geo/nearby queries across multiple public datasets (Airbnb, app stores, GitHub, jobs, housing, Google Maps, and more).
- Clean, consistent JSON results suitable for bulk analysis or large-scale filtering.
- Use for aggregate questions, finding all matches to criteria, or retrieving lists, rather than scraping individual records.
- Setup via a free API key; 2,000 credits/month free tier.
- Results reflect pre-indexed data periodically refreshed, not real-time.
